3.outfitText: - HYKE double-faced trench coat: warm camel double-faced wool with a soft brushed surface. - HYKE lambswool sweater: charcoal-grey soft wool crew neck; only a narrow band of grey knit shows inside the stand collar.
- HYKE TA wide leg pants: black, matte, fluid, very wide straight legs with front pleats, full length, the hem falling over the boots so only the toes and the chunky soles show.
- FABIO RUSCONI side-gore short boots: black smooth leather, round toe, black elastic side gores, a thick black lug tank sole. Mostly hidden under the trouser hem; never a close-up of the boots.

Camera at ANKLE height on a lower basalt column, OFF to one side, a wide 28mm lens shooting steeply upward: she stands at the very EDGE of the tallest hexagonal basalt column, high above the camera, placed in the RIGHT third of the frame; beside her the drop falls away to the black sand, the grey sea and the sea stacks far below on the left. The boots and the column edge are sharp at the bottom of the frame; she towers to the top. ACTION: She stands on the very edge of the column top with BOTH boots firmly planted, weight in one hip, both hands deep in the pockets of the closed khaki coat; the wind lifts her hair and the coat hem.

ATTITUDE: she owns the place and nothing here impresses her. Hands are quiet, in a coat pocket, resting on the stone or iron, or hanging. She never bends toward anything; when she looks at something below her, only her eyes go down.

FACE: Emotionless, eternal beauty — a face that reveals nothing, like a sculpture. Chin up, she looks DOWN into the lens from high above, as if she built the edge. No smile.

LIGHT: flat, cold overcast early-morning light under a thick low grey sky, soft and even, almost no shadow, a damp sea haze in the distance. Expose for her face: the khaki-beige coat keeps its matte texture, the black trousers keep their depth and do not go flat black. No flash, no lens flare. Her face is lit from one side, so a soft natural shadow falls in the hollow under each cheekbone, exactly as in the face reference photo; this light shapes a slim face with a narrow chin. It is light and shadow only, never added makeup or contour.

LENS AND FILM: Leica M6, Summicron 35mm, Kodak Vision3 500T cinema negative with a bleach-bypass process, handheld. A greyish, desaturated image with a cool blue-grey cast through the shadows and midtones: colours are muted to about half strength, reds and greens are dull, skin is pale and cool, blacks are dense, highlights are clean and slightly silvery. Visible fine grain. It looks overcast-cool even in sunlight. No cut-out edge, no digital sharpening.

NEVER: a bowed head, a polite catalogue stance, a bag, added text or logos, readable signs, written characters, watermarks, borders, camera equipment, a second bag, changed garments, a rounder or younger face, a smile, closed eyes, an elongated body, hands touching hair or face, a rear view, a full profile, bare skin at the waist, a coat worn over the shoulders without the arms in the sleeves, crowds, people close to her, sitting, climbing, a foot over the drop, hovering, other people, lettering on boats, a coat worn open, white socks, a bag.
